description: Known vulnerabilities that remain in a pinned image because no fixed upstream release exists, and that image scanners cannot see. Each entry is bound to the exact upstream pin it was reviewed for: scripts/release/check-residual-risks.sh fails when that pin changes, so the next upstream release is reviewed deliberately. See docs/RELEASING.md#residual-risks.

risks.summary: Qdrant 1.18.3 links Zstandard 1.5.x statically into /qdrant/qdrant, where Trivy does not report it. zstd 1.5.1 to 1.5.7 are affected; 1.6.0 fixes it. No Qdrant release bundles 1.6.0 yet. Exploitability in Qdrant is unverified.
risks.resolveWhen: A Qdrant release bundles zstd 1.6.0 or later: pin it in a new hive-qdrant version and a datastore profile, then remove this entry.
